items.prompt:
Staying true to the original text is being:
A) faithful
B) a departure
C) unrelated

Cutting or changing scenes from the text is a:
A) departure
B) faithful choice
C) citation

A director's decision about how to film a scene is a creative:
A) choice
B) error
C) summary

A film cuts a major character from the novel. This departure can:
A) change the plot, relationships, and meaning
B) have no effect at all
C) only change the title
items.answer: A) change the plot, relationships, and meaning

steps: Removing a character shifts the story. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) change the plot, relationships, and meaning

items.prompt:
An actor plays a villain as sympathetic rather than purely evil. This choice:
A) makes the villain more complex and may shift our sympathies
B) has no effect
C) changes the book's words
items.answer: A) makes the villain more complex and may shift our sympathies

steps: Interpretation shapes character. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) makes the villain more complex and may shift our sympathies

items.prompt:
Why do directors sometimes DEPART from the original text?
A) to fit the medium's needs or offer a new interpretation
B) by accident only
C) to copy it exactly
items.answer: A) to fit the medium's needs or offer a new interpretation

solution.answer: A) to fit the medium's needs or offer a new interpretation

items.prompt:
A stage production of a tragedy adds a hopeful final scene not in the script. A careful analyst would note that this departure:
A) reinterprets the author's meaning, softening the tragedy
B) is identical to the original
C) cannot affect meaning
items.answer: A) reinterprets the author's meaning, softening the tragedy

steps: Added scene changes meaning. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) reinterprets the author's meaning, softening the tragedy

items.prompt:
To evaluate a film adaptation, the BEST approach is to:
A) compare its choices to the text and judge how they affect the meaning
B) only check which is longer
C) assume the film is always wrong
items.answer: A) compare its choices to the text and judge how they affect the meaning

steps: Compare and evaluate choices. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) compare its choices to the text and judge how they affect the meaning
